{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A tailored black blazer cut from a fluid wool-silk blend with slightly dropped shoulders to allow ease of movement through a crowd.
Black high-waisted trousers in a stretch crepe fabric that skim the leg and fall straight to the ankle for comfort while standing.
Red suede loafers with a low block heel, chosen to provide stability on uneven club floors without sacrificing style.
A thin gold chain necklace worn against the skin tone #e3c3a2, adding a subtle pop of elegance that catches the artificial club lights.

This outfit works perfectly for a Friday rock concert at a club because it balances the need to move freely within a dense crowd with a polished yet approachable aesthetic. The black blazer and trousers adhere to the "social" smart dress code while the stretch fabrics ensure she remains comfortable standing or dancing for hours. The red suede loafers offer the necessary grip and height for her 154 cm stature, grounding the silhouette without feeling restrictive. Finally, the minimalist gold jewelry complements her warm skin tones #e3c3a2 and #dcb995, ensuring she looks refined yet ready for the energy of the event."}
